koharu_api_base_url.hint: Koharu HTTP API 位于 /api/v1。可填写 http://host:port 或 http://host:port/api/v1。

target_language.hint: 指令未指定语言时，作为 Koharu pipeline 的 targetLanguage。

pipeline_steps.hint: 逗号分隔的 Koharu engine id。留空则从 Koharu /config 读取当前选择的 pipeline 引擎。

system_prompt.hint: 可选，每次运行传给 Koharu pipeline 的 systemPrompt。

auto_load_llm.hint: 如果 Koharu 未预先加载翻译模型，可启用此项。

llm_kind.hint: provider 使用 providerId + modelId；local 只使用 modelId。

llm_provider_id.hint: 仅当 llm_kind 为 provider 时使用。

llm_temperature.hint: 填 -1 表示不传此选项。

llm_custom_system_prompt.description: LLM 自定义系统提示词

max_images_per_request.hint: 填 0 表示插件侧不限制。

max_send_images.hint: 填 0 表示返回全部渲染图片。

queue_depth.hint: 同时等待翻译的最大请求数。并发固定为 1，超出队列深度的请求将被直接拒绝。填 0 表示不允许排队。

compress_return_images.hint: 启用后会在发送前将翻译结果转码压缩，降低触发聊天平台文件大小上限的概率。

return_image_format.hint: 仅在启用压缩返回图片时生效。JPG 不支持透明通道，会使用白色背景合成。

metadata.short_desc: Translate manga images with Koharu.

koharu_api_base_url.hint: Koharu exposes HTTP API under /api/v1. Both http://host:port and http://host:port/api/v1 are accepted.

target_language.hint: Used as targetLanguage when the command does not provide a language.

pipeline_steps.hint: Comma-separated Koharu engine ids. Leave empty to read the selected pipeline engines from Koharu /config.

system_prompt.hint: Optional per-run systemPrompt passed to Koharu pipeline.

default_font.hint: Optional per-run defaultFont passed to Koharu pipeline.

auto_load_llm.hint: Enable this if Koharu does not already have a translation model loaded.

llm_kind.hint: provider uses providerId + modelId. local uses only modelId.

llm_provider_id.hint: Used only when llm_kind is provider.

llm_model_id.hint: Leave empty to skip auto loading. Must match a model shown by Koharu /llm/catalog.

max_send_images.hint: Use 0 to send all rendered images.

queue_depth.hint: Max number of requests waiting for translation. Concurrency is fixed at 1; requests exceeding the queue depth are rejected immediately. Use 0 to disallow queuing.

compress_return_images.hint: When enabled, translated results are transcoded before sending to reduce the chance of hitting chat platform file-size limits.

return_image_format.hint: Only used when return image compression is enabled. JPG does not support transparency and uses a white background.

return_image_quality.hint: Only used when return image compression is enabled. Range: 1-100. Lower values produce smaller files with lower quality.

delete_project_after_export.hint: After closing the project, call DELETE /projects/{id} to remove the project folder from Koharu.

result_retention_policy.hint: Controls cleanup for translated images under data/plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_koharu/outputs/.

result_retention_days.hint: Only used when retention policy is Keep by days. Use 0 to delete on the next cleanup after sending.

metadata.short_desc: 基于知识库的长期记忆、召回和管理工具。
metadata.desc: 为 AstrBot 提供长期记忆能力，基于内置知识库实现用户偏好、历史交互和重要事实的记忆存储与召回。

kb_name.hint: 选择用于存储长期记忆的知识库（必填，请先在知识库管理中创建，知识库需配置嵌入模型）

extraction_provider_id.hint: 用于从对话中提取记忆的 LLM 模型（留空则使用会话主 LLM）

summarization_provider_id.hint: 用于记忆合并、压缩等总结操作的 LLM 模型（留空则使用会话主 LLM）

auto_memorize.hint: 开启后会在对话后自动提取并存储记忆

extraction_interval.hint: 每 N 轮对话后触发一次记忆提取，对这 N 轮对话内容进行总结

extraction_min_content_length.hint: 对话总内容低于此字符数时跳过记忆提取，避免无意义短对话被记忆

global_memory.hint: 开启后同一用户可跨会话召回个人记忆；关闭后仅召回当前会话的个人记忆

max_memories_per_inject.hint: LLM 请求时注入的最大记忆条数

max_memory_list_scan.hint: 限制 /memory list 为计算当前用户可见记忆而扫描的最大记录数。实际扫描量会按当前页码和每页数量推导，并不会超过此上限

memory_delete_scan_page_size.description: 记忆删除扫描分页大小
memory_delete_scan_page_size.hint: 删除或清空记忆前，每页扫描多少条匹配记录用于同步清理知识库文档记录。数值越大速度越快但单次内存占用更高

memory_ttl_days.hint: 超过此天数的低频记忆将被压缩为印象

use_reranker.hint: 记忆召回时使用知识库配置的重排序模型优化结果排序。需先在知识库设置中配置重排序模型，未配置时此选项无效

optimize_recall_query.hint: 开启后在每次记忆召回前调用记忆提取模型提炼检索关键词，提高召回准确率。每次对话都会调用，建议配置响应速度快的轻量模型

optimize_recall_query_timeout.hint: 限制检索优化模型调用的最长等待时间。超时后将跳过优化并使用原始检索内容，避免阻塞对话响应

enable_admin_global_memory_tool.description: 启用管理员全局记忆工具
enable_admin_global_memory_tool.hint: 开启后提供 memory_store_global 工具，仅管理员可通过 AI 添加对所有会话生效的全局记忆

recall_sparse_fusion.hint: 召回时在稠密向量之外追加 FTS5 关键词稀疏检索，并用 RRF 融合两路结果，提升关键词/专有名词召回率。依赖知识库 FTS5 索引，不可用时自动回退纯稠密

recall_weight_importance.hint: 召回结果二次排序中 importance 的权重（0-1）

recall_weight_frequency.hint: 召回结果二次排序中 recall_count 频次的权重（0-1）

recall_weight_recency.hint: 召回结果二次排序中时间衰减的权重（0-1）

recall_recency_halflife_days.hint: 时效衰减半衰期：距今 N 天的记忆时效分约为 0.5

memory_consolidation_enabled.hint: 定期将低频老旧记忆交由 LLM 压缩为摘要印象，原文标记为已废弃。需配置总结模型

consolidation_min_age_days.hint: 仅巩固创建超过此天数的记忆

consolidation_max_recall.hint: 仅巩固历史召回次数不超过此值的低频记忆（避免压缩高频使用中的记忆）

consolidation_batch_size.hint: 每次巩固任务处理的记忆条数上限

metadata.short_desc: Knowledge-base backed long-term memory, recall, and management tools.
metadata.desc: Adds long-term memory to AstrBot using the built-in knowledge base for user preferences, past interactions, and important facts.

kb_name.hint: Select the knowledge base used to store long-term memories. Required. Create one first in Knowledge Base Management and configure an embedding model.

extraction_provider_id.hint: LLM used to extract memories from conversations. Leave empty to use the current chat model.

summarization_provider_id.hint: LLM used for future memory merging and compression. Leave empty to use the current chat model.

auto_memorize.hint: When enabled, memories are automatically extracted and stored after conversations.

extraction_interval.hint: Run memory extraction every N conversation turns and summarize those turns.

extraction_min_content_length.hint: Skip memory extraction when the accumulated conversation is shorter than this many characters.

global_memory.hint: When enabled, personal memories can be recalled across sessions for the same user. When disabled, only personal memories from the current session are recalled.

max_memories_per_inject.hint: Maximum number of memories injected into each LLM request.

max_memory_list_scan.hint: Limits how many records /memory list scans to calculate memories visible to the current user. The actual scan amount is derived from the page and page size and will not exceed this limit.

memory_delete_scan_page_size.hint: Number of matched records scanned per page before deleting or clearing memories. Larger values are faster but use more memory per operation.

memory_ttl_days.hint: Low-frequency memories older than this many days may be compressed into impressions.

use_reranker.hint: Use the knowledge base reranker to improve memory recall ordering. Requires a reranker model configured on the knowledge base.

optimize_recall_query.hint: Before each memory recall, call the extraction model to extract search keywords for better recall accuracy. This runs on every conversation, so use a fast lightweight model.

optimize_recall_query_timeout.hint: Maximum wait time for recall query optimization. On timeout, the original query is used so conversation responses are not blocked.

enable_admin_global_memory_tool.hint: When enabled, provides the memory_store_global tool so administrators can ask AI to add global memories that apply to all chats.

recall_sparse_fusion.hint: Adds FTS5 keyword sparse retrieval atop dense vector search and fuses both via RRF, improving recall for keywords/proper nouns. Falls back to dense-only when FTS5 is unavailable.

recall_weight_importance.hint: Weight of importance in recall re-ranking (0-1)

recall_weight_frequency.hint: Weight of recall_count frequency in recall re-ranking (0-1)

recall_weight_recency.hint: Weight of time decay in recall re-ranking (0-1)

recall_recency_halflife_days.hint: Recency decay halflife: a memory N days old scores about 0.5

memory_consolidation_enabled.hint: Periodically compress low-frequency old memories into summary impressions via LLM; originals are marked deprecated. Requires a summarization model.

consolidation_min_age_days.hint: Only consolidate memories older than this many days

consolidation_max_recall.hint: Only consolidate low-frequency memories with recall count at or below this (avoids compressing frequently-used memories)

consolidation_batch_size.hint: Maximum number of memories processed per consolidation run

metadata.short_desc: 让 AI 聊天机器人自主学习对话风格、群组黑话、社交关系和人格演化。
metadata.desc: SELF LEARNING 自主学习插件，让 AI 聊天机器人自主学习对话风格、理解群组黑话、管理社交关系与好感度、自适应人格演化，像真人一样自然对话。使用前请手动备份人格数据。

Dependency_Install_Guide.hint: 依赖不会在插件安装或启动时自动安装。请进入插件 WebUI Dashboard 的全量设置顶部，手动点击基础能力依赖或全能力依赖。

dependency_install_entry.hint: 基础能力依赖：人格审查、黑话学习、表达方式学习与 WebUI 所需依赖。全能力依赖：在基础能力上增加图谱、监控、外部数据库、LightRAG 与 Mem0 等完整能力依赖。

Self_Learning_Basic.hint: 控制插件的基本学习行为

enable_message_capture.hint: 是否抓取用户消息用于学习。关闭后插件将停止收集新消息

enable_auto_learning.hint: 是否启用定时自动学习。关闭后需要手动触发学习

enable_realtime_learning.hint: 是否在收到消息时立即进行筛选处理。会增加实时负载

enable_jargon_learning.hint: 是否启用黑话统计预筛、黑话挖掘和黑话上下文能力

enable_style_learning.hint: 是否启用自动风格学习、表达模式和相关学习批次处理

enable_realtime_llm_filter.hint: 是否对每条实时消息都使用LLM进行筛选。关闭可减少LLM调用频率

enable_web_interface.hint: 是否启用Web界面用于查看和管理学习数据

web_interface_port.hint: Web管理界面的访问端口号

web_interface_host.hint: Web管理界面绑定的地址。0.0.0.0 表示监听所有网卡（局域网可访问），127.0.0.1 表示仅本机可访问

Target_Settings.hint: 配置要学习哪些用户的消息

target_qq_list.hint: 默认全量学习：留空、空行或填写 all/*/全部/全量 时学习所有非黑名单消息。也可填写个人QQ号或群聊格式 group_群号 作为白名单。

target_blacklist.hint: 黑名单内的成员消息不进行学习。为空则没有黑名单。支持个人QQ号和群聊格式group_群号

current_persona_name.hint: 插件将学习并优化此人格的对话风格。留空或填 default 表示跟随 AstrBot 当前人格；填写具体 ID 时需在人格设置中存在

Model_Configuration.hint: 配置用于筛选和提炼的AI模型提供商

filter_provider_id.hint: 用于消息筛选的提供商，建议选择速度快、成本低的模型如gpt-4o-mini

refine_provider_id.hint: 用于深度分析和提炼对话风格的提供商，建议选择能力强的模型如gpt-4o

reinforce_provider_id.hint: 用于强化学习的提供商，建议选择能力强的模型

Learning_Parameters.hint: 控制学习过程的各种参数

learning_interval_hours.hint: 自动学习的时间间隔，单位为小时

min_messages_for_learning.hint: 开始学习所需的最少消息数量

max_messages_per_batch.description: 每批处理的最大消息数量
max_messages_per_batch.hint: 单次学习处理的最大消息数量，避免一次处理过多消息

expression_learning_trigger_messages.description: 表达方式学习触发消息数
expression_learning_trigger_messages.hint: 每个群每新增多少条原始消息才触发表达方式学习。调大可降低筛选/分析模型调用频率

topic_detection_interval_messages.hint: 每个群每新增多少条消息才进行一次LLM话题检测。调大可降低筛选模型调用频率

message_min_length.hint: 参与学习的消息最小字符长度

message_max_length.hint: 参与学习的消息最大字符长度

confidence_threshold.hint: 消息筛选的置信度阈值，0-1之间，越高越严格

Style_Analysis.hint: 控制对话风格分析的参数

style_analysis_batch_size.hint: 单次风格分析处理的消息数量

style_update_threshold.hint: 触发人格风格更新的置信度阈值，0-1之间

debug_mode.hint: 启用函数级性能监控，并在未指定日志等级时自动使用 debug

log_level.hint: 控制插件在 AstrBot 日志中的详细程度。error 最少，debug 最多

save_raw_messages.hint: 是否保存未经处理的原始消息用于分析

auto_backup_interval_days.hint: 学习数据自动备份的间隔天数，0为禁用

auto_apply_approved_persona.description: ⚠️ 审查批准后自动应用到默认人格
auto_apply_approved_persona.hint: 【危险功能 - 谨慎开启】批准人格审查后自动将内容直接应用到当前使用的默认人格，而非创建新人格副本。开启后将直接覆盖正在使用的默认人格的系统提示词，此操作不可逆（除非从备份恢复）。强烈建议同时开启人格自动备份功能以防止数据丢失

Machine_Learning_Settings.hint: 轻量级机器学习分析配置

enable_ml_analysis.hint: 是否启用scikit-learn进行文本聚类和行为分析

max_ml_sample_size.hint: 机器学习分析的最大样本数量，控制资源使用

ml_cache_timeout_hours.hint: 机器学习分析结果的缓存时间

Persona_Backup_Settings.hint: 人格数据备份和恢复配置

auto_backup_enabled.hint: 是否在人格更新前自动创建备份

max_backups_per_group.hint: 每个群保留的最大备份数量

Goal_Driven_Chat_Settings.description: 目标驱动对话系统设置
Goal_Driven_Chat_Settings.hint: 智能对话目标管理系统，支持动态目标检测和阶段规划

enable_goal_driven_chat.hint: 是否启用智能对话目标系统。启用后会自动检测对话目标并动态调整回复策略

goal_session_timeout_hours.hint: 对话目标会话的超时时间，超过该时间未活跃的会话将被自动清理

goal_auto_detect.hint: 是否自动使用LLM分析用户消息检测对话目标类型。关闭后使用默认的闲聊模式

goal_max_conversation_history.hint: 保留在会话中的最大对话轮次（用户消息+Bot回复=1轮）。建议20-40轮

Affection_System_Settings.hint: 用户好感度和bot情绪管理配置

enable_affection_system.hint: 是否启用用户好感度和情绪响应系统

max_total_affection.hint: bot对所有用户的总好感度上限值

max_user_affection.hint: 单个用户可获得的最大好感度

affection_decay_rate.hint: 好感度重新分配时的衰减比例，0-1之间

daily_mood_change.hint: 是否每天随机更换bot的情绪状态

mood_affect_affection.hint: 当前情绪是否影响好感度变化幅度

enable_daily_mood.hint: 是否启用每日随机情绪系统

enable_startup_random_mood.hint: 插件启动时是否为活跃群组设置随机初始情绪

mood_persistence_hours.hint: 每次情绪状态持续的小时数

Social_Context_Settings.hint: 控制向LLM prompt注入社交关系、好感度和情绪信息

enable_social_context_injection.hint: 是否向LLM prompt中注入用户社交关系、好感度和情绪信息

include_social_relations.hint: 是否在prompt中包含用户的社交关系网络信息

include_affection_info.hint: 是否在prompt中包含对该用户的好感度信息

include_mood_info.hint: 是否在prompt中包含Bot当前的情绪状态信息

expression_patterns_hours.description: 风格特征提取时间范围(小时)
expression_patterns_hours.hint: 从多少小时内提取学到的表达风格特征注入到prompt中，默认24小时，可设置为7*24=168小时(一周)

context_injection_position.hint: 社交上下文注入到prompt的位置，可选值：start(开头)、end(结尾)

Storage_Settings.hint: 自定义插件数据存储位置

data_dir.hint: 插件数据存储的根目录路径。默认位于 AstrBot 数据目录的 plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_self_learning 下；可以改为绝对路径

Database_Settings.hint: 配置数据库类型和连接参数。默认使用 PostgreSQL；插件会尝试自动创建 PostgreSQL 数据库、schema 和 ORM 表。SQLite 和 MySQL 可作为显式配置的兼容后端。

db_type.hint: 填写 postgresql、pgsql、sqlite 或 mysql。默认使用 PostgreSQL，启动时会先建库和 schema，再同步 ORM 表；单机无 PostgreSQL 服务时可显式改为 sqlite

mysql_host.hint: MySQL服务器的IP地址或域名，如：localhost 或 192.168.1.100（仅当db_type为mysql时需要填写）

mysql_port.hint: MySQL服务器的端口号，通常为3306（仅当db_type为mysql时需要填写）

mysql_user.hint: MySQL数据库的用户名，如：root 或 astrbot（仅当db_type为mysql时需要填写）

mysql_password.hint: MySQL数据库的密码（仅当db_type为mysql时需要填写）

mysql_database.hint: MySQL数据库名称。使用MySQL 自动创建数据库以及数据库表

postgresql_host.hint: PostgreSQL服务器的IP地址或域名（仅当db_type为postgresql时需要填写）

postgresql_port.hint: PostgreSQL服务器的端口号，通常为5432（仅当db_type为postgresql时需要填写）

postgresql_user.hint: PostgreSQL数据库的用户名，如：postgres 或 astrbot（仅当db_type为postgresql时需要填写）

postgresql_password.hint: PostgreSQL数据库的密码（仅当db_type为postgresql时需要填写）

postgresql_database.hint: PostgreSQL数据库名称。插件会尝试自动创建数据库以及数据库表

postgresql_schema.hint: PostgreSQL schema 名称。默认 public；填写其他名称时插件会自动创建并使用该 schema

max_connections.hint: 数据库连接池的最大连接数，高并发场景可适当增加

min_connections.hint: 数据库连接池的最小连接数，保持一定预热连接提高性能

api_key.hint: 外部API接口的访问密钥。留空则不需要密钥认证。建议设置一个强密码保护API安全

enable_api_auth.hint: 是否启用API密钥认证。关闭后任何人都可以访问外部API接口

Repository_Settings.hint: 配置SQLAlchemy Repository数据访问的默认参数和限制

default_review_limit.description: 默认审查记录查询数量
default_review_limit.hint: 获取待审查的人格学习/风格学习记录时的默认数量限制

default_pattern_limit.description: 默认表达模式查询数量
default_pattern_limit.hint: 获取表达模式时的默认数量限制

default_memory_limit.hint: 获取记忆记录时的默认数量限制

default_affection_limit.description: 默认好感度记录查询数量
default_affection_limit.hint: 获取好感度交互记录时的默认数量限制

default_social_limit.description: 默认社交记录查询数量
default_social_limit.hint: 获取社交关系记录时的默认数量限制

default_psychological_limit.description: 默认心理状态记录查询数量
default_psychological_limit.hint: 获取心理状态记录时的默认数量限制

max_interaction_batch_size.hint: 批量处理交互记录时的最大数量限制，避免单次处理过多数据

top_patterns_limit.hint: 获取权重最高的表达模式时的默认数量限制

recent_interactions_limit.hint: 获取近期交互记录时的默认数量限制

trend_analysis_days.hint: 进行趋势分析时默认查询的天数范围

Integration_Settings.hint: 与专门插件协同：记忆交给 LivingMemory，回复决策和生成交给 Group Chat Plus。本插件保留学习、审查、黑话、表达方式和上下文注入能力。

delegate_memory_to_livingmemory.hint: 开启后，检测到 LivingMemory 插件已加载时，本插件不再写入或注入本地长期记忆，避免双重记忆系统互相污染。

livingmemory_plugin_name.hint: 用于检测 LivingMemory 插件是否已加载。通常保持默认值即可。

disable_local_memory_when_delegated.hint: 开启后，只有检测到 LivingMemory 时才禁用本插件本地长期记忆；LivingMemory 未加载时自动保留本地降级能力。

delegate_reply_to_group_chat_plus.description: 回复交给 Group Chat Plus
delegate_reply_to_group_chat_plus.hint: 开启后，检测到 Group Chat Plus 插件已加载时，本插件不再接管回复决策和回复生成，只负责学习上下文增强。

group_chat_plus_plugin_name.hint: 用于检测 Group Chat Plus 插件是否已加载。通常保持默认值即可。

disable_local_reply_when_delegated.hint: 开启后，只有检测到 Group Chat Plus 时才禁用本插件本地回复器；目标插件未加载时保留兼容降级。

V2_Architecture_Settings.hint: 高级功能配置：Embedding向量化、Reranker重排序、知识引擎和记忆引擎。需要先在AstrBot中配置对应类型的Provider

embedding_provider_id.hint: 填写Embedding提供商的完整ID（如 'openai/text-embedding-3-large'）。需要先在AstrBot的Provider管理中创建Embedding类型的提供商，然后将其ID填写到此处。格式通常为 '来源名/模型名'

rerank_provider_id.hint: 填写Reranker提供商的完整ID（如 'openai/qwen3-rerank'）。需要先在AstrBot的Provider管理中创建Reranker类型的提供商，然后将其ID填写到此处。格式通常为 '来源名/模型名'

rerank_top_k.hint: Reranker重排序后保留的Top-K结果数量，值越小越精准但可能遗漏

rerank_min_candidates.description: 触发重排序的最低候选文档数
rerank_min_candidates.hint: 当知识+记忆候选文档数量低于此阈值时，跳过Reranker以节省延迟。设为0则始终执行重排序

provider_retry_interval_seconds.hint: AstrBot 冷启动时 Provider 注册表可能尚未就绪。插件会按此间隔重试绑定 Embedding/Reranker Provider。

knowledge_engine.hint: 知识存储引擎类型。legacy=现有NetworkX实现，lightrag=使用LightRAG进行向量+图谱混合检索（需配置Embedding提供商）

lightrag_query_mode.hint: LightRAG检索模式。local=仅实体邻域检索（低延迟），hybrid=实体邻域+全局社区聚合（高质量但慢约4-5秒），naive=纯向量检索，global=仅全局社区，mix=混合模式

memory_engine.hint: 记忆管理引擎类型。legacy=现有实现，mem0=使用mem0进行自动记忆提取和检索（需配置Embedding提供商）

metadata.desc: SELF LEARNING lets an AI chatbot learn conversation style, understand group jargon, manage social relationships and affection, and evolve its persona for more natural conversations. Back up persona data manually before use.

Dependency_Install_Guide.hint: Dependencies are not installed automatically during plugin installation or startup. Open the plugin WebUI Dashboard full settings and manually install basic or full capability dependencies.

dependency_install_entry.hint: Basic dependencies cover persona review, jargon learning, expression learning, and WebUI features. Full dependencies add graph, monitoring, external database, LightRAG, Mem0, and other complete capabilities.

Self_Learning_Basic.hint: Controls the plugin's basic learning behavior.

enable_message_capture.hint: Capture user messages for learning. When disabled, the plugin stops collecting new messages.

enable_auto_learning.hint: Run scheduled automatic learning. When disabled, learning must be triggered manually.

enable_realtime_learning.hint: Filter and process messages as they arrive. This increases real-time load.

enable_jargon_learning.hint: Enable jargon pre-filtering, mining, and context capabilities.

enable_style_learning.hint: Enable automatic style learning, expression patterns, and related learning batches.

enable_realtime_llm_filter.hint: Use an LLM to filter every real-time message. Disable this to reduce LLM call frequency.

enable_web_interface.hint: Enable the Web UI for viewing and managing learning data.

web_interface_port.hint: Access port for the Web management UI.

web_interface_host.hint: Bind address for the Web management UI. 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces; 127.0.0.1 is local only.

Target_Settings.hint: Configure whose messages should be learned.

target_qq_list.hint: Default full learning: leave empty, blank, or enter all/*/全部/全量 to learn all non-blacklisted messages. You can also enter a QQ ID or group_ group-id value as a whitelist.

target_blacklist.hint: Messages from blacklisted members are not learned. Empty means no blacklist. Supports QQ IDs and group_ group-id values.

current_persona_name.hint: The plugin learns and optimizes the conversation style for this persona. Empty or default follows the current AstrBot persona; a specific ID must exist in persona settings.

Model_Configuration.hint: Configure AI model providers used for filtering, refinement, and reinforcement learning.

filter_provider_id.hint: Provider used for message filtering. Fast and low-cost models such as gpt-4o-mini are recommended.

refine_provider_id.hint: Provider used for deep analysis and conversation style refinement. Stronger models such as gpt-4o are recommended.

reinforce_provider_id.hint: Provider used for reinforcement learning. A capable model is recommended.

min_messages_for_learning.hint: Minimum number of messages required before learning starts.

max_messages_per_batch.hint: Maximum messages processed in a single learning run to avoid oversized batches.

expression_learning_trigger_messages.hint: How many new raw messages per group trigger expression learning. Increase this to reduce filter/analysis model calls.

topic_detection_interval_messages.hint: How many new messages per group trigger one LLM topic detection. Increase this to reduce filter model calls.

message_min_length.hint: Minimum character length of messages included in learning.

message_max_length.hint: Maximum character length of messages included in learning.

confidence_threshold.hint: Message filter confidence threshold from 0 to 1. Higher values are stricter.

style_analysis_batch_size.hint: Number of messages processed in one style analysis run.

style_update_threshold.hint: Confidence threshold from 0 to 1 for triggering persona style updates.

debug_mode.hint: Enable function-level performance monitoring and automatically use debug logs when no log level is specified.

log_level.hint: Controls plugin log verbosity in AstrBot logs. error is minimal; debug is most verbose.

save_raw_messages.hint: Whether to save unprocessed raw messages for analysis.

auto_backup_interval_days.hint: Learning data auto-backup interval in days. 0 disables it.

auto_apply_approved_persona.description: Auto-apply approved reviews to the default persona
auto_apply_approved_persona.hint: Dangerous feature. After persona review approval, apply content directly to the currently used default persona instead of creating a new persona copy. This overwrites the default persona system prompt and is irreversible unless restored from backup. Strongly enable persona auto-backup when using this.

enable_ml_analysis.hint: Enable scikit-learn for text clustering and behavior analysis.

max_ml_sample_size.hint: Maximum sample count for machine learning analysis to control resource usage.

ml_cache_timeout_hours.hint: Cache lifetime for machine learning analysis results.

Persona_Backup_Settings.hint: Persona data backup and restore configuration.

auto_backup_enabled.hint: Create backups automatically before persona updates.

max_backups_per_group.hint: Maximum backups retained for each group.

Goal_Driven_Chat_Settings.hint: Intelligent conversation goal management with dynamic goal detection and stage planning.

enable_goal_driven_chat.hint: Enable the intelligent conversation goal system. It detects conversation goals and dynamically adjusts reply strategy.

goal_session_timeout_hours.hint: Conversation goal session timeout. Inactive sessions past this time are cleaned automatically.

goal_auto_detect.hint: Use an LLM to analyze user messages and detect conversation goal type. When disabled, the default casual chat mode is used.

goal_max_conversation_history.hint: Maximum conversation turns kept in a session. One user message plus one bot reply counts as one turn. Recommended: 20-40.

Affection_System_Settings.hint: User affection and bot mood management configuration.

enable_affection_system.hint: Enable user affection and emotional response system.

max_total_affection.hint: Maximum total affection value the bot can hold across all users.

max_user_affection.hint: Maximum affection a single user can receive.

affection_decay_rate.hint: Decay ratio used during affection redistribution, from 0 to 1.

daily_mood_change.hint: Randomly change the bot's mood every day.

mood_affect_affection.hint: Whether the current mood affects the magnitude of affection changes.

enable_daily_mood.hint: Enable the daily random mood system.

enable_startup_random_mood.hint: Set a random initial mood for active groups when the plugin starts.

mood_change_hour.hint: Hour of day for mood updates, from 0 to 23.

mood_persistence_hours.hint: How many hours each mood state persists.

Social_Context_Settings.hint: Controls injection of social relationships, affection, and mood into LLM prompts.

enable_social_context_injection.hint: Inject user social relationships, affection, and mood information into LLM prompts.

include_social_relations.hint: Include the user's social relationship network information in the prompt.

include_affection_info.hint: Include affection information for the user in the prompt.

include_mood_info.hint: Include the bot's current mood state in the prompt.

expression_patterns_hours.hint: How many recent hours of learned expression style features are injected into the prompt. Default is 24 hours; use 168 for one week.

context_injection_position.hint: Where to inject social context into the prompt. Options: start or end.

Storage_Settings.hint: Customize the plugin data storage location.

data_dir.hint: Root directory for plugin data. Defaults to plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_self_learning under the AstrBot data directory; absolute paths are allowed.

Database_Settings.hint: Configure database type and connection parameters. PostgreSQL is the default; SQLite and MySQL are compatible explicit backends.

db_type.hint: Enter postgresql, pgsql, sqlite, or mysql. PostgreSQL is the default; startup creates database/schema before syncing ORM tables. Use sqlite explicitly when PostgreSQL is unavailable on a single machine.

mysql_host.hint: IP address or domain of the MySQL server, such as localhost or 192.168.1.100. Required only when db_type is mysql.

mysql_port.hint: MySQL server port, usually 3306. Required only when db_type is mysql.

mysql_user.hint: MySQL database username, such as root or astrbot. Required only when db_type is mysql.

mysql_password.hint: MySQL database password. Required only when db_type is mysql.

mysql_database.hint: MySQL database name. The plugin can automatically create the database and tables.

postgresql_host.hint: IP address or domain of the PostgreSQL server. Required only when db_type is postgresql.

postgresql_port.hint: PostgreSQL server port, usually 5432. Required only when db_type is postgresql.

postgresql_user.hint: PostgreSQL database username, such as postgres or astrbot. Required only when db_type is postgresql.

postgresql_password.hint: PostgreSQL database password. Required only when db_type is postgresql.

postgresql_database.hint: PostgreSQL database name. The plugin will try to create the database and tables automatically.

postgresql_schema.hint: PostgreSQL schema name. Default is public; other names are created and used automatically.

max_connections.hint: Maximum database connection pool size. Increase for high concurrency.

min_connections.hint: Minimum database connection pool size to keep warm connections available.

API_Settings.hint: Security configuration for external API endpoints.

api_key.hint: Access key for external API endpoints. Leave empty to disable key authentication. A strong password is recommended.

enable_api_auth.hint: Enable API key authentication. When disabled, anyone can access external API endpoints.

Repository_Settings.hint: Configure default limits and parameters for SQLAlchemy Repository data access.

default_review_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching pending persona/style learning review records.

default_pattern_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching expression patterns.

default_memory_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching memory records.

default_affection_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching affection interaction records.

default_social_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching social relationship records.

default_psychological_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching psychological state records.

max_interaction_batch_size.hint: Maximum number of interaction records processed in one batch to avoid oversized operations.

top_patterns_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching the highest-weight expression patterns.

recent_interactions_limit.hint: Default limit when fetching recent interaction records.

trend_analysis_days.hint: Default day range queried for trend analysis.

Integration_Settings.hint: Coordinate with specialized plugins: delegate memory to LivingMemory and reply decisions/generation to Group Chat Plus.

delegate_memory_to_livingmemory.hint: When LivingMemory is loaded, this plugin no longer writes or injects local long-term memory, avoiding double-memory contamination.

livingmemory_plugin_name.hint: Used to detect whether the LivingMemory plugin is loaded. Usually keep the default.

disable_local_memory_when_delegated.hint: When enabled, local long-term memory is disabled only if LivingMemory is detected; otherwise local fallback remains available.

delegate_reply_to_group_chat_plus.description: Delegate replies to Group Chat Plus
delegate_reply_to_group_chat_plus.hint: When Group Chat Plus is loaded, this plugin no longer handles reply decisions or generation and only enhances learning context.

group_chat_plus_plugin_name.hint: Used to detect whether the Group Chat Plus plugin is loaded. Usually keep the default.

disable_local_reply_when_delegated.hint: When enabled, the local reply system is disabled only if Group Chat Plus is detected; otherwise compatible fallback remains available.

V2_Architecture_Settings.hint: Advanced features: embedding vectorization, reranker sorting, knowledge engine, and memory engine.

embedding_provider_id.hint: Enter the full Embedding provider ID, such as 'openai/text-embedding-3-large'. Create an Embedding provider in AstrBot Provider management first, then enter its ID here. The format is usually 'source/model'.

rerank_provider_id.hint: Enter the full Reranker provider ID, such as 'openai/qwen3-rerank'. Create a Reranker provider in AstrBot Provider management first, then enter its ID here. The format is usually 'source/model'.

rerank_top_k.hint: Number of Top-K results kept after reranking. Smaller values are more precise but may miss relevant results.

rerank_min_candidates.hint: Skip Reranker when the number of knowledge + memory candidate documents is below this threshold to save latency. Set to 0 to always rerank.

provider_retry_interval_seconds.hint: AstrBot provider registry may not be ready during cold start. The plugin retries binding Embedding/Reranker providers at this interval.

knowledge_engine.hint: Knowledge storage engine type. legacy uses the existing NetworkX implementation; lightrag uses LightRAG hybrid vector + graph retrieval and requires an Embedding provider.

lightrag_query_mode.hint: LightRAG retrieval mode. local uses entity-neighborhood retrieval with low latency; hybrid combines entity-neighborhood and global community aggregation for higher quality but slower results; naive is pure vector retrieval; global is global community only; mix is mixed mode.

memory_engine.hint: Memory management engine type. legacy uses the existing implementation; mem0 uses mem0 for automatic memory extraction and retrieval and requires an Embedding provider.

llm_agent.msg: No malware, reverse shells, destructive behavior, hidden downloads, unsafe eval/exec, persistence mechanisms, suspicious install hooks, or targeted prompt-injection instructions were found. metadata.short_desc: Intelligent long-term memory for AstrBot
metadata.desc: An intelligent long-term memory plugin with hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector + graph), WebUI management, and dynamic lifecycle. Supports session/persona isolation, importance decay, and auto-cleanup.

bot_language.hint: Set the language for plugin command and status replies. zh=Chinese (default), en=English, ru=Russian.

provider_settings.hint: Configure the AI models used by the memory system

embedding_provider_id.hint: The Embedding model ID used to generate memory vectors. Leave blank to use AstrBot default. You can find existing Embedding Provider IDs in the AstrBot admin panel under 'LLM Configuration' (e.g., openai_embedding).

llm_provider_id.hint: The large language model ID used for summarizing conversations and evaluating memory importance. Leave blank to use AstrBot default. A model with strong reasoning capabilities is recommended.

session_manager.hint: Manage user session states and conversation history caching behavior

max_sessions.hint: Maximum number of sessions kept in memory (LRU eviction). Once exceeded, the least recently used session is removed from cache, but data remains in the database.

session_ttl.hint: Sessions inactive for longer than this duration are removed from cache. Default is 3600 (1 hour).

context_window_size.hint: Maximum number of historical messages passed to the LLM. Larger values provide richer context but consume more tokens. Recommended: 20-100.

max_messages_per_session.hint: Maximum number of historical messages retained per session in the database. When exceeded, only the oldest summarized messages are deleted to avoid losing unsummarized context.

cleanup_batch_size.hint: Minimum number of old summarized messages to delete per batch when the session history exceeds the limit. A value too small will cause only a few messages to be deleted each round after overflow.

recall_engine.hint: Control memory retrieval and injection into conversations

top_k.hint: Number of most relevant memories returned per retrieval. Set to 0 to skip automatic recall/injection while keeping historical injection cleanup. Recommended: 3-10.

max_k.hint: Maximum memories returned when the Agent actively calls the long-term memory retrieval tool. Used to limit single-tool recall scale. Recommended: 5-10.

importance_weight.hint: Weight coefficient for memory importance in the hybrid scoring. Higher values prioritize high-importance memories.

fallback_to_vector.hint: Automatically fall back to pure vector search when hybrid retrieval fails or returns empty results. Recommended to keep enabled.

injection_method.hint: Where to inject memories into LLM requests. user_message_before: as a user message prefix; system_prompt: append to system prompt; user_message_after: as a user message suffix; fake_tool_call: inject as a fake tool call message pair into conversation history, letting the LLM naturally understand this as retrieval results.

auto_remove_injected.hint: Automatically remove previously injected memory fragments from history before injecting new ones, preventing duplicate accumulation and token waste. Recommended to keep enabled.

importance_decay.hint: Gradually reduce the importance of old memories over time to prevent outdated information from retaining high weight indefinitely

decay_rate.hint: The proportion of memory importance decayed per day. 0.01 means a 1% decrease daily. Set to 0 to disable decay.

fusion_strategy.hint: Fusion parameters for BM25 and vector search results (internally uses the RRF algorithm)

rrf_k.hint: Lower values emphasize top-ranked results; higher values produce smoother fusion. Recommended: 30-120. Default is 60.

use_persona_filtering.hint: When enabled, only memories related to the current persona are recalled. Memories of different personas do not interfere with each other.

use_session_filtering.hint: When enabled, each session's memories are stored independently and not shared across sessions.

reflection_engine.hint: Control when conversation summarization is triggered and memories are generated

summary_trigger_rounds.hint: Trigger a summary and write it to memory after this many rounds of dialogue (one question and one answer counts as one round).

graph_memory.hint: When enabled, both document-based and graph-based paths are maintained simultaneously, each supporting keyword and vector retrieval, with results unified into a single fused recall set.

enabled.hint: When enabled, graph nodes, edges, and graph vector indexes are automatically built. Recommended to keep enabled.

document_route_weight.hint: The proportion of the document path fusion score in the final dual-path ranking.

graph_route_weight.hint: The proportion of the graph path fusion score in the final dual-path ranking.

cross_route_bonus.hint: Extra score added when the same memory is hit by both the document path and the graph path.

expansion_limit.hint: Maximum number of candidate entries expanded from hit nodes to their neighbors during graph keyword retrieval.

max_topics_per_memory.hint: Maximum number of topic nodes extracted from a single memory.

max_participants_per_memory.hint: Maximum number of participant nodes extracted from a single memory.

max_facts_per_memory.hint: Maximum number of key facts extracted from a single memory to enter the graph index.

migration_settings.hint: Control database version upgrade behavior on plugin startup

auto_migrate.hint: Automatically detect and upgrade outdated database versions on plugin startup. Recommended to keep enabled.

create_backup.hint: Automatically create a backup file before performing database migration to prevent data loss in case of migration failure. Recommended to keep enabled.

index_rebuild_settings.hint: Control batch size, Embedding request rate, and failure tolerance for the /lmem rebuild-index command. Low-spec cloud servers should keep concurrency small.

batch_size.hint: Number of memories read from the documents table per batch. Larger values increase memory peak and affect more entries on failure. Recommended: 25-100.

embedding_batch_size.hint: Number of texts included in a single Embedding API request. Reduce further if the provider has strict TPM rate limits.

tasks_limit.hint: Internal concurrency limit for batch Embedding. To avoid triggering API rate limits, the default is 1.

max_retries.hint: Maximum retry attempts for a failed Embedding batch.

retry_base_delay.hint: Base wait time for exponential backoff after a batch failure. At least 30 seconds will be waited when encountering 429/TPM rate limits.

batch_delay.hint: Additional wait time between each documents read batch, used to proactively reduce overall rebuild rate.

request_delay.hint: Wait time between each Embedding API sub-request. Increase this first if 429/TPM is triggered frequently.

max_failure_ratio.hint: During full vector rebuild, the new index will only be switched if the failure ratio does not exceed this value. 0.02 means up to 2% failure is allowed.

backup_settings.hint: Automatically back up the memory database daily to prevent accidental data loss

enabled.hint: Automatically back up the database after daily decay tasks. Recommended to keep enabled.

keep_days.hint: Backup files older than this number of days will be automatically deleted. Default is 7 days.

forgetting_agent.hint: Periodically clean up old memories that are both outdated and low importance to control memory store size

auto_cleanup_enabled.hint: Automatically clean up eligible old memories after daily importance decay.

cleanup_days_threshold.hint: Memories older than this many days become cleanup candidates. They will only be deleted if their importance is also below the threshold.

cleanup_importance_threshold.hint: Only memories with importance below this value will be cleaned up. 0.3 means memories below 30% importance.

treasure_bag_plugin.desc: 一个为 AstrBot 设计的多功能插件，包含多种实用和娱乐功能。
treasure_bag_plugin.author: 祁筱欣

llm_agent.msg: Plugin Python code is clean - standard API integrations for public services (hitokoto, Baidu face, weather, horoscope, handwriting). Shell scripts (install_gpg_keys.sh, install_agents.sh) are developer/CI tooling bundled in the repo, not executed by the plugin runtime. install_gpg_keys.sh downloads GPG keys from external endpoint and modifies bashrc, which is concerning for developers who run it but does not affect plugin safety. No malware, credential exfiltration, reverse shells, eval/exec abuse, or prompt injection found.

llm_agent.msg: Manual override (pass): No targeted prompt injection for reviewers/scanners, no eval/exec, no reverse shells, no credential exfiltration, no obfuscation, and no suspicious startup hooks were found. However, the package has unsafe filesystem path handling that can be destructive: LocalDataService uses unsanitized API/collection names as path components (e.g., local_dir/<type>/<name>), so a malicious API name containing .. or an absolute path can write files outside the plugin data directory (_save_binary creates arbitrary directories and writes files) and delete arbitrary directories/files (shutil.rmtree / Path.unlink in _delete_collection_one). PoolIOService.export_pool_to_file also honors arbitrary absolute/relative custom paths, allowing writes outside the intended pool_files_dir. These appear to be accidental unsafe-code issues rather than deliberate author poisoning, but they constitute destructive filesystem behavior.

metadata.short_desc: B站视频解析、UP主动态/直播订阅、番剧推荐
metadata.desc: 哔哩哔哩动态推送、视频信息解析、直播间状态推送、QQ小程序解析、基于 LLM 的 Bangumi 番剧推荐。

sessdata.hint: Bilibili 的 SESSDATA Cookie，用于获取动态和视频信息。获取方式详见 README。

proxy.hint: Bilibili API 请求代理地址。示例: http://127.0.0.1:7890 或 socks5://127.0.0.1:1080，留空则直连。

bangumi_token.hint: 可选。Bangumi (bgm.tv) 的 Access Token。调用需要授权的接口时请填写。

interval_secs.hint: 单个UP主任务的检测周期（秒）。默认 300 秒（5 分钟）。

task_gap_secs.hint: 相邻两个UP主任务的最小间隔秒数，用于控制 API 请求频率。

reconnect_silent.hint: 启用后，若启动时检测到长时间未成功推送订阅通知，则先静默一段时间以消化积压消息，避免刷屏。

rai.hint: 启用后以 HTML 卡片渲染图片形式推送动态与直播通知，视觉效果更好。关闭则使用纯文本模式。

renderer_template.hint: 选择动态/直播推送卡片的渲染样式。

node.hint: 启用后以转发消息（节点）形式推送动态，适用于 QQ 等支持转发消息的平台。

enable_parse_miniapp.hint: 启用后自动解析消息中的 Bilibili QQ 小程序卡片，提取直链。

enable_parse_BV.description: 解析 B 站视频链接
enable_parse_BV.hint: 启用后自动解析消息中的 BV 号和 b23.tv 短链接，回复视频详情卡片。

dynamic_limit.hint: 每个UP主每次轮询最大推送动态条数，避免一次性推送过多消息。

recent_dynamic_cache.hint: 用于去重的 recent_ids 缓存长度，越大去重范围越广但占用更多内存。

plain_push_template.hint: 非图片推送模式下的动态消息模板，留空使用默认格式。可用变量: {name}(UP主名称) {uid}(UID) {action}(动作) {title}(标题) {text}(正文) {url}(链接)。

plain_push_forward_template.hint: 非图片推送模式下的转发内容模板，留空使用默认格式。可用变量: {name} {uid} {title} {text} {url}（数据来源为被转发的原动态）。

enable_ai_summary.hint: 启用后在动态推送后额外调用 AI（LLM）生成内容摘要。需确保已配置有效的 AI 模型。

ai_summary_prompt.hint: 可选。自定义 AI 摘要的提示词模板。使用 {content} 代表组装后的动态内容。留空则使用内置默认提示词。

metadata.short_desc: Bilibili video parsing, dynamic/live subscription, bangumi recommendations
metadata.desc: Bilibili dynamic push, video info parsing, live room status notifications, QQ mini-app parsing, and LLM-based Bangumi anime recommendations.

sessdata.hint: Bilibili SESSDATA cookie for fetching dynamics and video info. See README for retrieval instructions.

proxy.hint: Proxy address for Bilibili API requests. Example: http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Leave blank for direct connection.

bangumi_token.hint: Optional. Bangumi (bgm.tv) access token. Required for authorized API endpoints.

interval_secs.hint: Detection interval per uploader in seconds. Default: 300s (5 minutes).

task_gap_secs.hint: Minimum interval between two consecutive uploader tasks in seconds, used to control API request rate.

reconnect_silent.hint: When enabled, if a long time has passed since the last successful push on startup, the plugin will stay silent for a period to digest the backlog.

rai.hint: When enabled, dynamic and live notifications are rendered as HTML card images for better visual effect. Disable to use plain text mode.

renderer_template.hint: Select the rendering style for dynamic/live push cards.

node.hint: When enabled, dynamics are sent as forward messages (nodes), suitable for platforms like QQ that support forwarded messages.

enable_parse_miniapp.hint: When enabled, automatically parse Bilibili QQ mini-app cards in messages and extract direct links.

enable_parse_BV.hint: When enabled, automatically detect BV numbers and b23.tv short links in messages and reply with video detail cards.

dynamic_limit.hint: Maximum number of dynamics pushed per uploader per polling cycle, to avoid flooding.

recent_dynamic_cache.hint: Size of the recent_ids deduplication cache. Larger values increase dedup range but use more memory.

plain_push_template.hint: Message template for non-image push mode. Leave blank to use the default format. Available variables: {name} (uploader name), {uid} (UID), {action} (action text), {title} (title), {text} (body), {url} (link).

plain_push_forward_template.hint: Forward content template for non-image push mode. Leave blank to use the default format. Available variables: {name}, {uid}, {title}, {text}, {url} (sourced from the forwarded original dynamic).

enable_ai_summary.hint: When enabled, an AI (LLM) summary is generated after each dynamic push. Requires a valid AI model configured.

ai_summary_prompt.hint: Optional. Custom prompt template for AI summaries. Use {content} to represent the assembled dynamic content. Leave blank to use the built-in default prompt.

Manual override (bypass): Plugin uses unsafe eval() on data read from YAML files (lines 130, 158, 184 of main.py). Keys in triggers.yml are deserialized via eval() instead of safe alternatives like ast.literal_eval() or json.loads(). This creates a code execution vulnerability if the YAML file is tampered with. Replace eval() with ast.literal_eval() to fix.
